entities.summary: Portugal is a sovereign nation in Southern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Lisbon. Official languages include Portuguese. Government: Unitary semi-presidential republic. Population: approximately 10.4 million. Area: 92,212 km². Comprehensive index for Portugal covering Lusitanian/Roman Lusitania, Visigothic kingdom, Moorish conquest (711-1139), Reconquista (Afonso Henriques 1139, first king), Age of Discovery (15th-16th century, Vasco da Gama, Brazil, Magellan circumnavigation), Iberian Union with Spain (1580-1640), 1755 Lisbon earthquake, Napoleonic invasion, Brazilian independence 1822, constitutional monarchy, First Republic 1910, Estado Novo dictatorship (Salazar 1933-74), Carnation Revolution 1974, EU 1986.
